title.en: How Do You Make a Small Choice Together?
title.zh: 一起选件小事：你会用哪种办法？

description.en: Six shared-choice scenes compare clarifying criteria, taking turns, trying a small sample and choosing separate parts. Four complete decision-style portraits await.
description.zh: 六个共同小选择场景，比较说清条件、轮流、短试与分选部分，四种完整趣味画像等你查看。

introduction.en: Imagine two willing people choosing an ordinary leisure activity. No method is best for every situation, and the four approaches can be combined. The result describes the choices in this game rather than fairness, decisiveness or the quality of a relationship.
introduction.zh: 想象双方愿意选一项普通休闲活动。没有哪种方法处处最好，四种方式也可组合。结果只描述本次选择，不评公平、果断或关系质量。

focus.en: Settling a small shared choice through explicit criteria, a turn arrangement, a bounded trial or a divisible plan.
focus.zh: 一起做小决定时，你更愿意先说清条件、轮流选、先试一小段，还是把活动拆成几部分？

prompt.en: You both suggest different activities. You first…

label.en: Ask which two conditions matter most to each person.
label.zh: 问各自最在意哪两个条件。

label.en: Offer a simple alternating-choice arrangement.
label.zh: 提一个简单轮流选择安排。

label.en: Suggest a short sample of one option before deciding further.
label.zh: 提议短试一个，再决定更多。

label.en: Look for a plan with separate parts each can choose.
label.zh: 找能分成部分、各自可选的计划。

prompt.en: Two options look equally appealing. You prefer to…
prompt.zh: 两个选项都吸引人，你更愿……

label.en: Choose one now and give the other person the next agreed turn.
label.zh: 这次选一个，下次给另一人已约轮次。

label.en: Compare the one difference that would actually affect the visit.
label.zh: 比较真正影响到访的一处不同。

label.en: Try the smallest version that can answer your uncertainty.
label.zh: 试能回答不确定的最小版本。

label.en: Use one part from each without forcing a single winner.
label.zh: 各取一部分，不强求唯一赢家。

prompt.en: A sample turns out different from what you imagined. You…
prompt.zh: 试一下发现与想象不同，你会……

label.en: Use that experience to decide whether you want more.
label.zh: 按体验决定是否还想更多。

label.en: Revisit the original conditions in light of what changed.
label.zh: 根据变化重看原先条件。

label.en: Let the next choice follow the turn arrangement if both still want it.
label.zh: 双方仍愿意时，让下一选择按已约轮次。

label.en: Keep the enjoyable piece and leave the rest separate.
label.zh: 留愉快部分，其余分开。

prompt.en: One person says a proposed method does not work for them. You…
prompt.zh: 一人说提议方法不适合自己，你会……

label.en: Ask which condition makes it unsuitable.
label.zh: 问什么条件让它不合适。

label.en: Change the turn arrangement rather than treating it as a debt.
label.zh: 改轮次安排，不把它当欠账。

label.en: Offer another small trial only if a trial is welcome.
label.zh: 只有欢迎试时，才另给小试。

label.en: Check whether making separate choices would be more comfortable.
label.zh: 问分开选择是否更舒服。

prompt.en: The activity can fit only a short time. You choose…
prompt.zh: 只有一小段活动时间，你选……

label.en: One small sample with an explicit finish.
label.zh: 一个有明确结束的小样本。

label.en: The option meeting the few conditions both named.
label.zh: 符合双方说过少数条件的选项。

label.en: One person’s choice for this agreed short round.
label.zh: 本次已约短回合由一人选。

label.en: Two brief separate parts and one optional meeting point.
label.zh: 两小段分选部分与一个可选碰面点。

prompt.en: What makes the choice feel settled?
prompt.zh: 怎样会让选择定得舒服？

label.en: We understood what the decision depended on.
label.zh: 明白决定依据是什么。

label.en: We had a turn arrangement we could both revise.
label.zh: 有一份双方都可修改的轮次安排。

label.en: We learned enough from trying without overcommitting.
label.zh: 试到足够了解，也没过度承诺。

label.en: We could share time without requiring one identical preference.
label.zh: 能共处，也不要求偏好相同。

title.zh: 说清两项条件的选择者

summary.en: Your shared choice becomes clearer when the relevant conditions are named. Time, interest or effort can be discussed before an option wins. The portrait follows your chosen decision method, not a score for rationality or a claim that feelings are less important.
summary.zh: 一起做小决定时，你更想先说清各自看重什么。时间、兴趣和需要花的精力，都可以在选定方案前讨论。这描述的是一种商量方法，不是在给理性打分，也不表示感受不重要。

example.en: Before choosing a short outing, you might learn that one person wants somewhere easy to leave and the other wants one unfamiliar thing to see.
example.zh: 安排一次短途外出前，你可能先了解到：一个人希望随时方便离开，另一个人想看点没见过的东西。

strength.en: A few explicit conditions can reveal a workable overlap and prevent the choice from becoming a contest between two unexplained favorites.
strength.zh: 说清几项条件，就容易找到双方都能接受的部分，不必只拿两个各自最爱的选项反复争论。

tradeoff.en: Comparing endlessly can use up the time meant for the activity. The conditions need only be clear enough for this small decision.
tradeoff.zh: 不停比较，也会用掉原本想一起玩的时间。条件说清到足够做这次小决定，就可以了。

experiment.en: For one minor shared choice, each name two conditions that matter. Find one option that fits enough, and stop comparing when both freely agree.
experiment.zh: 面对一次小决定，各说两个在意的条件。找一个够合适的方案，双方都自愿同意后，就不必继续比较。

summary.en: Your shared plan gives choosing a turn rather than asking every occasion to contain both first preferences. The arrangement remains something both people can revise. The result is not proof that exact alternation is the fairest method in every relationship.
summary.zh: 你愿意用轮流选择的方式安排共同活动，不要求每一次都同时满足双方的首选。这份安排也可以由双方重新商量。轮流是一种办法，但不意味着严格交替在所有关系里都最公平。

example.en: Two friends might agree to choose alternate short films for one afternoon, while keeping a clear option to stop or change the format.
example.zh: 两位朋友可约一个下午轮流选短片，也保留停下或换形式的清楚选项。

strength.en: An agreed turn can reduce repeated negotiation and make room for an experience one person would not have selected first on their own.
strength.zh: 约好轮流，可以减少反复协商，也让人有机会尝试自己原本不会优先选择的活动。

tradeoff.en: A turn can become a debt if consent is assumed forever. Rechecking the arrangement matters more than maintaining a perfect scorecard.
tradeoff.zh: 如果默认一次同意就永远有效，轮流也可能变成欠人情。重新确认彼此是否愿意，比把次数算得一分不差更重要。

experiment.en: Try a turn arrangement for one bounded leisure session only if both want it. Agree beforehand that either person can ask to revise the plan.
experiment.zh: 双方都愿意时，为一次有明确结束时间的休闲活动试试轮流。提前约好，任何一方都可以提出调整。

summary.en: Your decision starts with a little actual experience. A small sample can answer something discussion alone has not settled. The ending values a bounded test without claiming that another trial is always better than accepting a no.
summary.zh: 你倾向于先体验一小段，再做决定。有时，亲自试一下，比继续讨论更容易知道双方想不想参与。不过，尝试应该有范围，也不能用“再试一次”代替接受对方的拒绝。

example.en: You might try the first few minutes of a voluntary craft demonstration together, then choose whether the longer version interests both people.
example.zh: 你们可能自愿一起看几分钟手工演示，再决定是否都对完整版本有兴趣。

strength.en: A modest sample can turn an abstract preference into a clearer choice while keeping the cost of changing direction small.
strength.zh: 一小段体验，能让原本抽象的想法变得具体。即使决定换个方向，也不用付出太多成本。

tradeoff.en: Repeated samples can become the whole activity without agreement. Naming one question and one finish helps the trial stay small.
tradeoff.zh: 如果反复尝试却不事先商量，小体验也可能占掉整场活动。先说清想弄明白什么、何时结束，才能让它保持轻量。

experiment.en: Choose one small trial that can answer a real shared uncertainty. Decide its finish before starting and treat the result as information rather than an obligation to continue.
experiment.zh: 选一次能帮助双方弄清某个疑问的小尝试，开始前约好结束点。把体验结果当作参考，不必因此答应继续。

title.zh: 分开也能共享的选择者

summary.en: Your plan asks whether the choice can have more than one part. Separate preferences do not always need a single winner. The portrait describes a divisible leisure arrangement, not a claim that splitting up is the answer to every disagreement.
summary.zh: 你会想：这次活动能不能分成几个部分，让不同偏好都有位置？并不是每次都必须选出唯一的方案。这适合某些可以拆开的休闲安排，但不代表所有分歧都该靠分开行动解决。

example.en: At a small fair, you might each choose a different stall for a short stretch and then share one agreed final stop.
example.zh: 逛一个小市集时，你们可能先各去自己喜欢的摊位逛一会儿，再一起去事先约好的最后一站。

strength.en: A divisible plan can preserve both interests and make shared time flexible without requiring one person to abandon a genuine preference.
strength.zh: 分成几个部分，能保留双方的兴趣，也让共同时间更灵活，不必总由一个人放下自己的偏好。

tradeoff.en: A split can feel distant if one person wanted company for the main part. Naming what is shared keeps the plan understandable.
tradeoff.zh: 如果一方主要是想有人陪，分开行动也可能让人失落。把哪些时间一起、哪些时间分开说清楚，会更容易理解。

experiment.en: For one small outing, ask whether separate parts and one shared moment would suit both people. Keep staying together available too.
experiment.zh: 下次小范围外出前，问问各自逛一部分、再一起度过一小段时间是否合适。如果都想全程同行，也保留这个选择。

description.en: Six shared-choice scenarios compare criteria, taking turns, a bounded trial and dividing the plan. Read all four portraits, including every tied leader, before choosing a next step.
description.zh: 六个共同选择场景，比较准则、轮流、小试与拆分计划。先看四种完整画像及所有并列，再决定下一步。

question.en: When is splitting a plan different from compromising on one choice?
question.zh: 拆开计划，和在同一选项上折中有什么不同？

answer.en: Splitting works when the activity has parts people can choose separately. Criteria, turns and a bounded trial offer different ways to settle a shared part. The game does not prescribe one method for every disagreement.
answer.zh: 拆分适合活动中有可分别选择的部分；准则、轮流与有限小试，则以不同方式处理共同部分。游戏不为所有分歧规定同一种方法。
